phase3_findings.description: Docstring retained a stale cost-profile claim ('cost scales with the number of changed files') contradicted by the racy-backdate remedy which re-hashes all tracked files.
Changeset body ends with (#1138) while code cites #1117 — but #1138 is the PR number, which is the correct changeset citation convention.

notes: silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, comment-analyzer, type-design-analyzer all clean. pr-test-analyzer empirically confirmed AC1 (fails against pre-fix), AC2/AC3 coverage, and that the assume-unchanged test catches the wrong-remedy (unqualified add --renormalize). Only Important finding (doc accuracy) fixed; no Critical/behavioral findings.
